title: Read the crash
briefing: A service died. Its log knows why — the last error line tells the story.
tips: `grep ERROR file` keeps error lines; `tail -1` shows the last one.
objective: Find the last ERROR line in ~/app.log and print it.
hints: Filter the log to error lines, then take the final one.
`grep ERROR app.log | tail -1` shows the last error.

lines: 10:07:22 ERROR out of memory: killing worker

explanation: Logs are read bottom-up when something breaks: the LAST error is usually the cause. grep filters to what matters, tail shows the end. Together they turn a wall of text into an answer.
